intro.speaker: kabir
intro.text: The house knocked. The clock just sneezed. If the well burps, I’m going home.

brief.speaker: harpreet
brief.text: Baldev is safe. Find what pulled his door shut and where the village register went.

baldev.speaker: baldev
baldev.text: I moved the register to the blue drum upstairs to keep it dry. When I came back down, a gust tugged something and my door latched shut.

print.speaker: harpreet
print.text: A star pressed into the wax, right beside a strand of pink string. Whatever made it pulled the latch tight.

needPrint.speaker: kabir
needPrint.text: Wait. Something left a mark beside the latch. Check it before we go.

meher.speaker: meher
meher.text: I saw a monster with wings! Then lightning lit it up. It was a kite with a pink tail, flying toward the clock tower.

rohan.speaker: rohan
rohan.text: I left my star-shaped reel by Baldev’s door. The wind snatched the kite, and the pink string whipped right into the crack by the latch.

needFriends.speaker: kabir
needFriends.text: Meher saw the shadow. Rohan knows the string. Let’s hear both before climbing the tower.

bell.speaker: meher
bell.text: Achoo! The kite tail is tickling the bell and shaking dust out of it. There’s your sneezing clock.

reel.speaker: rohan
reel.text: My reel! The star matches the wax mark. Look, the pink string runs back down through the old signal pipe.

crate.speaker: harpreet
crate.text: Blue paint. A dry lid. There’s a little paper corner peeking out.

needTower.speaker: kabir
needTower.text: Check the dusty bell, the reel and the blue drum. Then tell me which one is hiding the book.

choose.speaker: kabir
choose.text: Detectives, where did Baldev put the register?

retryBell.speaker: meher
retryBell.text: The bell has plenty of dust. What colour did Baldev say to look for?

retryReel.speaker: rohan
retryReel.text: The reel tells us what pulled the latch. What did Baldev use to keep the book dry?

found.speaker: kabir
found.text: Village register, found! It’s so dry I can still smell the pencil.

solved.speaker: harpreet
solved.text: The wind yanked the kite string. The star reel hit the wax, the string swung the door shut, and Baldev’s latch clicked on its own.

laugh.speaker: meher
laugh.text: Case closed. Can someone get the clock a tissue?

tease.speaker: kabir
tease.text: Hang on. The last page says “Tomorrow, 12:17. Bring one very small umbrella.” Who’s that for?

saveResume.speaker: kabir
saveResume.text: Ready, detective? Let’s pick up where we left off.

cantCombine.speaker: kabir
cantCombine.text: Tap a clue to look at it up close.

chooseCause.speaker: harpreet
chooseCause.text: You found the register. Now fit the clues together. What pulled Baldev’s door shut?

choices.label: The wind tugged the kite string
The clock bell shook it shut

retryCause.speaker: meher
retryCause.text: The shadow had a pink tail. What connects that tail to the star mark by the latch?
